Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Servicii financiare
About Us:
 LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.
 What You’ll Be Doing:
 Own features end to end: refining requirements, technical design, building, testing, releasing and production rollout.
 Build and maintain rich, data-heavy Angular apps for the LSEG Workspace desktop and web platform, using modern Angular (standalone components, signals, RxJS, etc.).
 Build high-performance data grids and visualisations for ESG and sustainable-finance data, consistent with the LSEG Workspace design system.
 Design, build and maintain NestJS (Node.js/TypeScript) APIs that pull data from LSEG data platforms and serve it to our front ends.
 Work with Product Owners, UX, QA and engineers across regions to define scope, technical roadmap and release plans.
 Keep quality high with unit tests (Vitest/Jest) and end-to-end tests (Playwright), code reviews and clean, maintainable code.
 Maintain and improve GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including automated builds, tests, security and dependency scanning (SonarQube, Semgrep, audit-ci), semantic versioning and controlled releases.
 Provide Level 3 support for SFI applications and services: investigate issues across the UI and API layers.
 Keep technical documentation, specs and architecture decision records (ADRs) accurate and up to date.
 Evaluate new technologies, including AI-assisted development tools, and recommend improvements to the team.
 What You’ll Bring:
 A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Around 3–5 years of professional software development, mainly front end, with a solid grasp of the SDLC.
 Good, hands-on Angular (v16+) and TypeScript, with a good understanding of signals, RxJS, change detection, component architecture and performance.
 Good HTML and CSS/SCSS skills, including theming, accessibility and responsive layouts.
 Working experience with Node.js backend development, preferably NestJS (modules, dependency injection, DTOs and validation, OpenAPI/Swagger), and with REST API design and integration.
 Experience testing front end and back end (Vitest, Jest, Playwright or similar).
 Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Git workflows, Conventional Commits and automated release management.
 Good engineering practice: clean code, SOLID principles, design patterns, code reviews, security awareness.
 Agile experience and the ability to work well in global, multi-functional teams.
 Self-motivated, analytical and a quick learner, with a strong sense of ownership and a "can-do" attitude.
 Benefits :
We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career!
We maximise each employee’s potential through personal development through a wide range of learning tools both formal and informal. We believe in remunerating our people with competitive salaries and a range of attractive benefits such as:

Bookster

All LSEG colleagues with at least one year’s continuous service, who become parents, are now entitled to at least 26 weeks’ paid leave, and the option to return to work on a phased basis, in relation with specific company’s policy and guidelines
 Career Stage:
 Senior Associate
 LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.
 Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.
Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.
Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.
Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.
Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.
